item.title: LAB: Western Front lines, First World War (data for lessons) v0.1
item.snippet: Test layer: dated front lines on the Western Front, traced from public-domain maps. Version 0.1 has the front at the Armistice, 11 a.m. on 11 November 1918. Draft.
item.description:
Test layer. Front lines on the Western Front, each with the date it shows. Version 0.1 has one line: the front at 11 a.m. on 11 November 1918, when the Armistice came into force.

For the time slider: use ShowFrom as the start field and ShowTo as the end field.

How it was made: traced from the red front line on a US Army map of 1918 and placed on the ground using 16 towns. It is usually within about 4 km of the map's line (AccuracyKm), so it suits maps of Europe or a region, not close-up maps of villages.

Source: Order of Battle on Western Front, 11 A.M., Nov. 11, 1918, Map Room, G-3, General Headquarters, American Expeditionary Forces. Library of Congress, Geography and Map Division.

Data version 0.1 (26 November 2026), lab draft.
